terra.problem: Lydia heard Paul and was baptized in Philippi, not Thyatira. She was from Thyatira, but this moment did not happen there.
The command to send the scroll to seven churches was given to John on Patmos, not in Thyatira. Thyatira was one of its destinations.
The messages in Revelation 2:18–29 concern the church in Thyatira, but they were revealed to John on Patmos. They are not narrated as events happening in Thyatira.
Words such as “household” and “perseverance” may be above a fifth-grade reading level. Simpler alternatives include “everyone in her home” and “not giving up.”
